text: واہی بادشاہی، جے نہ جمے تاں پھاہی۔
romanized: Vahi badshahi, je na jammé ta phahi.
literal_en: Farming is as good as royalty, but if the crops do not grow well, it is a snare.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
